canonical_title: Excel and PowerPoint Terms: Workbook vs Worksheet, Animation vs Transition
aliases: Difference between animation and transition in PowerPoint

one_line_answer.text: A workbook is a spreadsheet file; a worksheet is a page within that workbook.

cites.quote: A workbook is a spreadsheet file; a worksheet is an individual spreadsheet or page within that workbook.

keywords.bn: slide-এর ভেতরে text বা objects-এর effect
এক slide থেকে আরেক slide-এ যাওয়ার effect

bangla_explanation: Workbook-এর ভেতরের প্রতিটা আলাদা page বা spreadsheet হলো worksheet।
PowerPoint-এ slide-এর ভেতরের text বা objects-এ যে effect দেওয়া হয়, সেটা animation।
এক slide থেকে আরেক slide-এ যাওয়ার সময়ের effect হলো transition।
সহজে মনে রাখুন: animation slide-এর ভেতরে, transition দুই slide-এর মাঝে।

example.en: At an IT training centre, one Excel workbook holds trainee marks. Each batch has its own worksheet.
example.bn: একটা marks file (workbook)-এর ভেতরে প্রতিটা batch-এর আলাদা sheet (worksheet)।

mnemonic.text: Book has sheets: workbook = whole file, worksheet = one page.
mnemonic.explain_bn: বইয়ের ভেতরে পাতা থাকে; তেমনি workbook-এর ভেতরে worksheet থাকে।

traps.text: The workbook is the file. The worksheet is one page within that workbook.

cites.quote: A workbook is a spreadsheet file; a worksheet is an individual spreadsheet or page within that workbook.

traps.text: Animation applies to text or objects within a slide. Transition is between slides.

cites.quote: Animation effects apply to text or objects within a slide; a transition is the effect used when moving from one slide to another.

short.prompt: What is the difference between (a) a worksheet and a workbook, and (b) animation and transition in PowerPoint?
short.modelAnswer:
(a) Worksheet vs workbook:
1. A workbook is a spreadsheet file.
2. A worksheet is an individual spreadsheet or page within that workbook.

(b) Animation vs transition:
1. Animation effects apply to text or objects within a slide.
2. A transition is the effect used when moving from one slide to another.
